//: POST {base}/InvoiceWS/createInvoice/{supplierTaxCode} — one VAT invoice, one line, VND, paid by transfer. Strip every // key before sending; JSON has no comments. Field notes: ../references/api-contract.md

generalInvoiceInfo.//invoiceType: TT78 code. "1" = hóa đơn GTGT. The TT32 vocabulary (01GTKT…) is the other era.
generalInvoiceInfo.//templateCode: mẫu số, from the portal or `vinvoice templates`
generalInvoiceInfo.//invoiceSeries: ký hiệu. NOT invoiceSeri — that is a search field. Max 25, ^[a-zA-Z0-9/]*$
generalInvoiceInfo.//adjustmentType: 1 gốc · 3 thay thế · 5 điều chỉnh thông tin · 7 xóa bỏ · 9 điều chỉnh tiền · 11 chiết khấu TM
generalInvoiceInfo.//invoiceIssuedDate: epoch MILLISECONDS. Seconds date the invoice to 1970.
generalInvoiceInfo.//transactionUuid: derive it from your own invoice row id — never a clock, never random, or a retry looks like a second sale

buyerInfo.//buyerLegalName: tên đơn vị, when the buyer is an organisation
buyerInfo.//buyerTaxCode: omit for a retail individual, and set buyerNotGetInvoice instead
buyerInfo.//buyerAddressLine: NOT buyerAddress — that name belongs to the search response
buyerInfo.buyerAddressLine: 123 Đường ABC, Quận 1, TP. Hồ Chí Minh
buyerInfo.//buyerEmail: Viettel sends the invoice here; the platform needs no mail path of its own
buyerInfo.//buyerNotGetInvoice: Integer. 0 = người mua CÓ lấy hóa đơn (default), 1 = KHÔNG lấy. The correct marker for a retail individual with no MST; the sale is still declared.

//payments: paymentMethodName is REQUIRED; paymentMethod defaults to 5 (KHAC) when omitted, which mislabels every transfer. Send both. Legacy codes 1 TM · 2 CK · 3 TM/CK · 4 DTCN · 5 KHAC; later ones 6 Tiền mặt · 7 Chuyển khoản · 8 Tiền mặt/Chuyển khoản · 9 Thẻ quốc tế.

itemInfo.//selection: line KIND, not a tax character: 1 hàng hóa · 2 ghi chú · 3 chiết khấu · 4 phí khác · 5 khuyến mại · 6 hàng hóa đặc trưng
itemInfo.//unitPrice: tax-EXCLUSIVE, as are the WithoutTax totals
itemInfo.//taxPercentage: 10 · 8 · 5 · 0, or -1 KCT / -2 KKKNT. The negatives are codes, not rates.
itemInfo.//taxAmount: the REMAINDER: gross - net. Never a second rounding.
itemInfo.//isIncreaseItem: direction on an adjustment line: true tăng, false giảm

//taxBreakdowns: one entry per distinct rate on the invoice
//metadata: an ARRAY of {keyTag, stringValue, valueType, keyLabel}
//validation: Do NOT send validation: 0. It makes Viettel accept these totals verbatim instead of recomputing them, discarding a free check that your arithmetic agrees with theirs.
//replacement-and-adjustment: adjustmentType 3 (thay thế) and 5 (điều chỉnh) additionally carry originalInvoiceId, originalInvoiceIssueDate (ms), additionalReferenceDesc, additionalReferenceDate (ms) — and 5 also adjustmentInvoiceType, with isIncreaseItem on every line. adjustmentType 7 (xóa bỏ) is how an invoice is voided under TT78, since the cancel endpoint is retired; confirm its exact shape on the sandbox before writing it.
